author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the DLSS 4.5 Trailer for War Thunder, a free-to-play vehicular combat simulation game developed by Gaijin Entertainment. Players will take to the battlefield with new visual upgrades on PC courtesy of DLSS 4.5, powered by NVIDIA. War Thunder is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, macOS, and PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: War Thunder - Official DLSS 4.5 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Proud Dragoon of Baron, Kain Highwind, dives into battle! Watch the latest Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy trailer for this upcoming action fighting game to see Kain Highwind in action. Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy will be available on iOS and Android in March 2026, and pre-registration is available now.

Warriors from the Final Fantasy series assemble in modern-day Tokyo to save the world from destruction in Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy. Fight in a 3vs3 Team Boss Battle Arena, where two teams fight monsters and clash in a race to defeat the powerful boss faster than the enemy team!
title: Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy - Official Kain Highwind Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the DLSS 4.5 Trailer for Where Winds Meet, a free-to-play multiplayer action RPG developed by Everstone Studio. Players will embody the legend of a lone swordsman in an unforgiving world set in ancient China to seek the truth of their own identity. Experience the game in unprecedented fidelity thanks to DLSS 4.5 to refine the game's image quality through NVIDIA software. Where Winds Meet is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: Where Winds Meet - Official DLSS 4.5 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Tangtang Operator Story Trailer for Arknights: Endfield, an anime action RPG developed by Hypergryph. Witness the narrative roots of the latest Operator to join the fight with Tangtang that's full of action, determination, and maybe a bit of creative liberties on exact events. Play as Tangtang in Arknights: Endfield for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official Tangtang Operator Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Ray Tracing & DLSS 4.5 Trailer for The Vernyhorn, an upcoming third-person open-world action RPG developed by Interstudio. Players will embody a man on a blood-soaked quest to face his demons through deep combat and decisions. Explore the European landscapes with full Ray Tracing and DLSS 4.5, offering enhanced image quality and performance powered by NVIDIA. The Vernyhorn is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia

#TheVernyhorn #NVIDIA
title: The Vernyhorn - Official Ray Tracing & DLSS 4.5 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the March 1.68 Update Trailer for Gran Turismo 7, the legendary car racing simulation franchise developed by Polyphony Digital. 

Players can gain access to a suite of new vehicles to hit the track with, such as the 1991 Mazda Efini RX-7 Type R, 1969 Chevrolet Camaro 1969 Race-Mod, and the 2021 Renault Captur S Edition TCE 140. 

The 1.68 Update for Gran Turismo 7 is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2).

#GranTurismo7 #Racing
title: Gran Turismo 7 - Official March 1.68 Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Introducing Kitman, a new job simulator game for 1-4 players in which you play as the kitman (aka equipment manager) for a professional football (soccer) team. You'll fix (and wash) kits, clean shoes, mop floors, and anything else it takes to put your team in the best possible position to go out on the pitch and win. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186890/Kitman/
title: Kitman: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault trailer for the action RPG to see what's available with the first big early access update, Greed and Glory. The Greed and Glory update for Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault brings the new combat path called HEX, the Greed Colosseum wave-based challenge mode, 20 new combat rooms, the 5th Key Narrative, and more. Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault is out now in PC via Early Access, and the Greed and Glory update is available now.

Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault's full 1.0 version will be available later in 2026 on PC, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault - Official Greed & Glory Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for DEFECT, an upcoming tactical shooter from EmptyVessel, a team made up of former Call of Duty, Doom and The Last of Us developers and published by NC America. The world of DEFECT is dark and dystopian, with a divisive and enigmatic AI called "The System" in charge. Players can hone their skills in an offline environment, or join up co-operatively for 4v4v4v4 PvP squads featuring explosive, close-quarter firefights featuring dynamic multi-objective battles with advanced weapons and tech. 
DEFECT is coming soon for PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, GoG)

#Defect #Gaming #IGN
title: DEFECT - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Sengoku Dynasty trailer for this open-world RPG with settlement-building and survival elements to see what's coming with the free Kanata update, which brings new content, including various gameplay additions and improvements. The Kanata update introduces a new subtropical archipelago with three distinct regions, new animals, new plants, extra player animations, bell tower upgrades, and a new enemy faction: pirates. The Kanata update for Sengoku Dynasty launches on PC on March 12, 2026.

#SengokuDynasty #Gaming #IGN
title: Sengoku Dynasty - Official ‘Kanata’ Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Black Sailors, a tactical naval game developed by Mandinga Games. Players will progress through the open seas with a narrative rooted deep in Afro-Brazilian history as enslaved Africans lead an uprising on a ship and assume control of the vessel. Exact revenge on colonial forces in Black Sailors, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#BlackSailors #Gaming #IGN
title: Black Sailors - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Save The World is going Free-To-Play! That's right! After nearly 10 years, the Save The World mode will be joining Battle Royale as free to play mode in the game. 

A 4-player co-op experience that has elements of survival games, base defense and of course: ZOMBIES! 

Fortnite Save The World goes free-to-play on April 16th.

#Fortnite #FortniteSaveTheWorld
title: Fortnite - Official Save The World Free-To-Play Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Dracamar in this trailer for the upcoming 3D action-adventure platformer featuring a fearless group of friends on an epic adventure to save their world. Explore the islands, run, jump, and fight the evil forces to rescue the magical Okis! Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the world and defeat the evil King Crad! Dracamar will be available on PC, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on March 26, 2026, and also coming to Nintendo Switch at a later date.
title: Dracamar - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Doug Bradley (voice of Pinhead) and the team at Saber Interactive and Boss Team Games for a behind-the-scenes look into Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival in this new video for the upcoming survival-horror action game. The team discusses the origins, story, and challenges in bringing the iconic universe to life in the video game. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

Embark on a battle for survival against Hell’s armies with a terrifying new story in the Hellraiser universe in Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival. Descend into the darkest depths of the underworld to rescue your love from an eternal realm of torment at the hands of the depraved Cenobites. Face your deepest fears against Hell’s most deviant wretches, cultists and creatures with the infernal powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box and an arsenal of earthly weapons.
title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Official 'Origins' Developer Diary

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the SongRunner announcement trailer for this upcoming puzzle platformer game where the platforms are your own musical loops! Speed through dozens of handcrafted single-screen challenges while creating your own platforms in time with a high-energy original soundtrack. SongRunner will be available on PC in 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.

#SongRunner #Platformer
title: SongRunner - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Intake Protocol, a prison intake officer simulation game developed by VortexTeam. Players will ensure the safety of incoming inmates to screen them, uncover potential security threats, and make decisions to protect the facility. Intake Protocol is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IntakeProtocol #Gaming #IGN
title: Intake Protocol - Official Announcement Trailer
